name: Forcewand
weapon_power: Heal per Magic Action in deck
chain_mechanic: Increase the damage of the next action by 1 per stack. Chain fades if a played card did not increase Chain.
synergies: Arcane Mastery (doubles Magic Actions in deck = more heals per turn)
Compassionate talent (+1 to all heals including weapon power heals)
build_fit: S-tier for Magic Action / Chain Arcanist. Basic attack builds chain; weapon power heals scale with deck size.
notes: Default Arcanist weapon. Pick this over Torch and Wintersprig for Magic Action builds.
